subject: POC gate decision flow & acceptance runway
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Roy <elena@finera.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: POC gate decision flow & acceptance runway

Hi Elena —

Quick MAP update and a proposal for the next decision gating cadence. We're tracking the PoC milestones against the acceptance criteria you shared; high level:

- Demo readiness: model integrated with your API gateway and baseline latency verified (target <= 150ms p95)
- Feature parity: Redwood reranking + system prompt controls available in the PoC environment
- Security & evidence: SOC2 evidence bundle and retention policy reviewed
- Ops readiness: rollback + canary plan for the first 10k requests/day

Attached is a lightweight MAP workbook (Finera_MAP-v2.xlsx) with owner rows. Proposed next steps:
1) Internal playbook review (Redwood): Oct 6–8
2) Security evidence handoff (Finera ask list) by Oct 10
3) Go/no-go working meeting: Oct 14 — decision gate for pilot ramp

Please confirm if Oct 14 works for your decision meeting; if not, suggest alternatives. If you want to expand acceptance criteria, note them in the spreadsheet and we'll incorporate.

Blockers we currently see:
- Longtail latency on specific test prompts (owner: Rishi)
- Missing retention proof for third-party logging (owner: Monica)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning the runway and owners so we can keep to a clean go/no-go on the 14th.

Best,
Michael Grant
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: Finera_MAP-v2.xlsx (workbook stub)

From: Elena Roy <elena@finera.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Tom Sato <tsato@nebulaai.com>
Date: 2027-10-06T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC gate decision flow & acceptance runway

Michael —

Thanks for the crisp summary and the MAP workbook. Oct 14 is OK for a decision meeting from our side; can we make it 10:00–11:00 PT? Two quick asks before then:

1) Security evidence: I sent our standard questionnaire to your security contact last week. Can Monica confirm which artifacts from your side map to the questionnaire sections?
2) Performance: the latency target is fine but we also need 99th percentile numbers for the longest prompts (20–30k tokens). Can Rishi share the current 99th estimates and whether staged quantization affects that?

I'll loop Tom from our infra team in case we need to escalate any infra-related blockers — he can join the working session.

Elena
Director of Data Platform, Finera
elena@finera.com | 415-867-4400

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>, Elena Roy <elena@finera.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-10T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC gate decision flow & acceptance runway

Elena / Michael —

Following up on the evidence request and current blockers. Quick status:

- Security artifacts: I attached a concise checklist that maps our deliverables to your questionnaire (security_evidence_checklist.pdf). Items on our side: SOC2 Type II report, KMS key rotation docs, and data flow diagram for the PoC environment. Expect the checklist to show which items are "final" vs "in progress."
- Latency 99th: Rishi ran a long-tail sweep yesterday; short summary below. Full numbers uploaded to the MAP workbook under the "performance" tab.
  - baseline (quantized int8): p95 = 135ms; p99 = 420ms for 4k prompts
  - long prompts (~20k tokens, context reused via KV cache): p95 = 480ms; p99 = 1.1s
  - Rishi notes: quantization increases variance on very long prompts; mitigation is a small kernel patch we can hotfix prior to pilot ramp (owner: Engineering — Vivek).
- Ops prep: we have a canary plan for the first 72 hours of ramp (10% traffic, automatic fallback to hosted model on error).

Blockers (current owners):
- Third-party logging retention proof (Owner: Monica) — target: Oct 12 deliverable
- Kernel variance on long prompts (Owner: Vivek) — mitigation ETA: Oct 12 (engineering spike)
- DocuSign SOW redline: legal review pending (Owner: Michael)

Related links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-1234 (tracking the kernel patch); MAP workbook in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B0Finera/POC-MAP

Attachment: security_evidence_checklist.pdf (summary stub)

Thanks — I will update the workbook and mark items as resolved as we close them.

—Monica
Platform Security Lead, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Roy <elena@finera.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Tom Sato <tsato@nebulaai.com>
Date: 2027-10-17T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC gate decision flow & acceptance runway

Team —

Thanks for the updates. Confirming the working session for Oct 14 was moved earlier in the thread; we held the meeting and landed on the following concrete actions and owners (closing the loop here so records match):

Action items (owners and short due dates):
- Monica: deliver final evidence bundle and map to Finera questionnaire — due: 2027-10-20
- Vivek: deploy kernel variance patch to staging and run long-tail perf tests — due: 2027-10-20 (Jira SUP-1234)
- Rishi: publish p99 test report and recommended runtime knobs — due: 2027-10-19
- Michael / Legal: finalize SOW redline and circulate DocuSign link — due: 2027-10-21
- Laura: prepare rollback runbook and monitoring dashboard for canary (10% traffic) — due: 2027-10-19

Decision summary:
- Go/no-go: conditionally green pending kernel patch and evidence bundle. If both are delivered by Oct 21, we proceed to pilot ramp on Oct 25 (10% traffic). If either misses the Oct 21 date, we postpone ramp until outstanding items are closed.

Notes:
- Monica will post the evidence checklist to the shared Drive folder and tag the exact doc links.
- Tom (Finera infra) — thanks for offering to attend the post-deployment smoke test; we will coordinate schedule once the patch is staged.

If anyone sees a discrepancy between this summary and meeting notes, flag it now so I can correct the MAP workbook.

Best,
Michael Grant
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment references: DocuSign template to be circulated; MAP workbook (Finera_MAP-v2.xlsx) updated in Drive.
